title: Component specifications describe styling no stylesheet applies
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
Six specifications document a visual treatment that no rule under `src/styles/` produces. Each was checked against the component's own sheet.

- `components/Table.md:155` promises sortable headers turn `var(--color-accent)` on hover. `src/styles/components/table.css` has one `:hover` rule, at `:233`, and it is for rows.
- `components/Table.md:100` gives the table `background: var(--card)`. `var(--card)` does not appear in `table.css`, so the table takes whatever is behind it.
- `components/StatusBadge.md:60` gives the label `var(--font-weight-medium)`. The label carries `text-label-upper`, which is `var(--font-weight-semibold)` at `src/styles/utilities.css:4`.
- `components/Panel.md:57` pins the title at `11px`. It resolves through `--font-size-label` to 12px, and `DESIGN_SYSTEM_SPEC.md:614` agrees with the code.
- `components/Input.md:98` and `components/SearchInput.md:81` give the placeholder `var(--muted)`. Both sheets use `var(--color-neutral)`, which differs in both themes.
- `components/SplitPane.md:64` describes the hit area as a `::before` extending 2px on each side. `src/styles/components/split-pane.css` has no `::before`, and the real child element is offset to one side instead.

Each of these misleads someone matching their own markup to the library's.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.

The SplitPane bullet is done, in bfc6163. `components/SplitPane.md` now describes the hit area as the child element it is, `0.5rem` wide and offset `-0.25rem`, rather than a `::before` extending evenly on both sides. The Table, StatusBadge, Panel and placeholder bullets are still open.

The placeholder bullet needs a decision and was left alone during the Input pass. `components/Input.md:98` and `components/SearchInput.md:81` say `var(--muted)`, and both sheets use `var(--color-neutral)`. Changing the sheets repaints every placeholder in both themes and moves the baseline. Changing the documents blesses the colour that ships today. Neither is obviously right, so it is for the repository owner rather than a session agent.

The placeholder bullet is done, in 92ce7e2. The owner chose to document the colour that ships rather than repaint every placeholder, so `components/Input.md` and `components/SearchInput.md` now name `var(--color-neutral)`. The Table, StatusBadge and Panel bullets are still open.

The StatusBadge and Panel bullets are done, in f866878, on the same principle the owner set for the placeholder: name what ships. StatusBadge is semibold through the `text-label-upper` utility, and Panel's title is `--font-size-label` at 0.75rem rather than a hard-coded 11px.

The two Table bullets are left open, and they are a different shape. Both are absences rather than wrong values: no `:hover` rule for a sortable header, and no `var(--card)` background. Naming what ships would mean deleting two documented affordances, and adding them would repaint every table. Either way it is a product decision rather than a correction.
